module.using_tour.description.text: Welcome to a tour of the Go programming language. The tour covers the most important features of the language, mainly:

module.basics.description.text:
The starting point, learn all the basics of the language.

Declaring variables, calling functions, and all the things you need to know before moving to the next lessons.

module.methods.description.text: Learn how to define methods on types, how to declare interfaces, and how to put everything together.

module.generics.description.text: Learn how to use type parameters in Go functions and structs.

module.concurrency.description.text:
Go provides concurrency features as part of the core language.

This module goes over goroutines and channels, and how they are used to implement different concurrency patterns.

site.title.text: A Tour of Go Multilingual Translation Project

site.intro.text: A community-maintained translation project for official Go learning content. Simplified Chinese is the first available language, and the structure can grow to support more languages and Go content.

site.no_affiliation.text: This project is not affiliated with, authorized by, or endorsed by the Go project.

site.tour_description.text: An interactive introduction to the Go programming language.

site.development_log.text: Development log: A Tour of Go Multilingual Translation Project

site.translation_validation_intro.text: The project keeps the learning experience close to the official source while checking every release before publication.

site.validation_page_unit.text: Translations use complete course pages as their unit.

site.validation_present.text: Each release is parsed with present.

site.validation_structure.text: The page structure is compared with the official source.

site.validation_render.text: Rendered pages are checked before release.

site.validation_examples.text: Go examples on the right remain as close to the official source as possible.
